submitted.prompt: Create ONE original Daoist Q-style game UI emotion speech-bubble icon as a finished transparent PNG. Use the two attached images ONLY as visual style references for the existing jade, warm gold and ivory hand-painted Daoist game interface. Do not reproduce their text, people, scene, UI layout, or any QQTang art. The subject is a simple circular, slightly squashed round ivory silk-paper emotion face inside a soft pale jade outline, with one short speech tail pointing down-left. The bubble itself fills about 80 percent of the square, centered with a generous fully transparent margin. The tail is contained inside that same overall silhouette. Front-facing flat 2D game icon, rounded and cute, subtle hand-painted warm ivory body, restrained gold rim and pale jade edge. Strong readable dark jade facial marks, designed to remain legible at 34 by 33 pixels. A joyful laughing face: two closed upward arch eyes, peach pink blush cheeks, and a wide open happy smile with a small ivory tooth line. Keep the face marks very simple and centered; no character body, ears, hats, hair, arms, props, decoration around the face, letters, words, numerals, watermark, floor, backdrop, gradients outside the cutout, or cast shadow. Real RGBA transparency around the isolated speech bubble; do not render a white or checkered background. This is a new original drawing for one emotion, not a contact sheet or a layout of several expressions.
